QuestInfo.name: The Tears of Time
QuestInfo.0: There was no more time to waste, so they went to #p2400000# to discuss their plans.
QuestInfo.1: #p2400000# suggested that the duo activate all of the #bGoddess Teardrops#k to gather power of time into one.
QuestInfo.2: #p2400005# and #p2400006# defeated the strange creature known as #o9300798# once they had activated the Goddess Teardrops. They returned to #p2400000#, but even she didn't know what was happening.

0.0: You've done it! My goodness, you've finally done it. The Goddess Teardrops are all safe in one place.
0.1: It is high time you activated your true powers. With the energy from these #bGoddess Teardrops#k, you should be able to escape Mirror World as a true Transcendent...

yes.0: I'll be watching you both with pride in my heart.

1.0: Goodness, I was so worried! You both just disappeared. What happened?!
1.1: The Dusk Temple, you say? Gracious... The temple is located deep within the Temple of Time. It is a place of old gods, Transcendents who existed before our Rhinne was the Goddess of Time. It is strange that you would be taken there.

yes.0: And a monster called Pink Bean? That is most troubling. There should be no monsters in that sacred place... I believe you two need to hurry up and use the Goddess Teardrops to transcend to your full powers, before something bad happens.
